razonamiento: Veritiv's architecture processes on-premises invoice sales data and ERP flat file orders to calculate demand analytics. The on-premises database connects through a VPN to AWS DMS, which populates an Amazon Redshift cluster that loads data into the data lake. In parallel, flat files land in an Amazon S3 drop bucket, triggering Amazon SQS, which invokes an initiator AWS Lambda function. This function queries Amazon DynamoDB for file metadata and places the structured data into the data lake. An S3 event trigger on the data lake then invokes a complex AWS Lambda function to merge datasets, run stats models, and feed the output demand data back into Amazon Redshift.
nombre: Veritiv Serverless Data Lake and Demand Analytics Architecture
